title: Yeluoli: Shijian Yu

alternative_titles.en: The Fairy Dream of Yeloli: Rain of Time

synopsis:
A clash between the time magic of Shi Xi (the Princess of Time) and the spatial magic of Li Hui (the King of Domains) swept the fairies of Yeloli Fairyland into a child's inner world. In this whimsical realm of toys, they must successfully complete the child's games and puzzles to return to their own world. Meanwhile, through the Clock of Four Seasons, Shi hope glimpsed the mysteries of the universe, witnessing the magnificent spectacle of fantastical galaxies and celestial worlds beyond Earth.

(Source: Mango TV, translated)
